full_judgment: SAN Mominur Rahman J: The Rule was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why Office Order No. 1146 dated 25-2-2007 circulated under Memo No. 1146/1(8) dated 25-2-2007, issued under the signature of the respondent No. 3, constituting an Ad-hoc Managing Committee superseding the existing elected Managing Committee of Bohumukhi Khudra Kutir Shilpa Samabava Samity Ltd, evidenced by Annexure-D to the writ petition, should not be declared t be without lawful authority and of no legal effect.
